name: p2flux
description: Let Claude find and pay for web pages that sell to AI agents, in USDC, within limits you set. The wallet stays on your computer.
long_description: Some websites ask AI assistants to pay a few cents to read an article or use their data (the open x402 standard). This extension gives Claude a small wallet on your computer and lets it pay those sites for you - never more than the limits you set here. P2Flux never holds your money or your key. Start by asking Claude: "Set up my P2Flux wallet."

network.title: Money
network.description: "test" = practice with free test money (recommended first). "live" = real USDC on Base.

max_per_payment.title: Most to pay for one page (USDC)
max_per_payment.description: Claude never pays more than this for a single page.

max_per_day.title: Most to spend in a day (USDC)
max_per_day.description: Everything that leaves the wallet in 24 hours, together.

max_prepaid.title: Prepaid balance per site (USDC, 0 = off)
max_prepaid.description: Some sites let Claude put a small amount aside once and then read pages without a fee each time. This is the most that may be put aside at one site.

tools.name: wallet_setup
tools.description: Create the wallet and show how to add money

tools.name: find_paid_content
tools.description: Search sites that sell to AI agents

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: What a page costs, without paying

tools.name: read_paid
tools.description: Read a page, paying within the limits
